Production PIXEL ART for the existing Sproto fighting game. Crisp stepped pixels, dark outlines, compact limited-color shading. Not smooth vector or painterly art. Each cell contains exactly ONE complete actor facing RIGHT, consistent three-quarter side view. Preserve the reference identity, facial shape, exact eye count, colors, clothing, accessories and slender long torso. Same head, torso and limb proportions in every frame. Exactly two arms and two legs per actor, legs rooted at the LOWEST pelvis below the belly. Low hip, chambered knee and connected ankle for every kick. Never attach legs to the chest. Keep all limbs and feet wholly inside their own cell with generous empty margins; no clipping. Flat solid pure MAGENTA #ff00ff background, no grid lines, labels, shadows, trails, floating particles or weapons. Worn/held identity accessories must remain attached to body or hand. Extend cropped lower bodies conservatively using matching skin/clothing colors and simple shoes. Complete separate body drawings; no limb cutouts. Both feet need readable soles. No extra subjects.
IDENTITY: Royal cobalt BLUE oversized rounded head with long angular swept BLUE spikes at the rear and a small blue top forelock. TWO enormous touching circular YELLOW eye regions, BLACK round pupils and tiny white glints, blue curved eyelids and brows. Very broad thick projecting RED smiling lips with a curved closed seam. Smooth YELLOW crescent below the mouth along the lower jaw, not white teeth. BLUE neck. BLACK shirt with a very thick rolled YELLOW GOLD collar exactly like reference. Tiny paired yellow decorative strokes on chest, no lettering. Conservatively extend the cropped lower body as BLACK long trousers and simple BLACK shoes with subtle yellow soles. BLUE bare arms and hands, no gloves. One actor with exactly two attached arms and two attached legs. No crown, red spikes, cape, weapon, white teeth or additional accessories. Reference image2 is the reviewed combat sheet; match its face, costume, proportions and crisp pixel style precisely.
Exactly EIGHT separate full-body drawings in a regular 4-column by 2-row grid. A continuous guarded fighting footwork loop, NOT a run. Upper body stays calm, head/torso size constant, hips stay at the same height and same x center. Both fists remain raised. No feet crossing through one another, no sliding torso, no detached hips. Each frame has at least one clearly grounded foot. Last frame loops to first. Same complete body and clothing as the combat reference. Preserve huge circular yellow eyes, cobalt swept head, broad red smile, yellow jaw crescent and thick gold collar in every frame. BLACK clothing throughout, no white patches. Crisp flat limited same-hue shading, no soft gradients. Do not draw pink reference background, text, effects or projectiles.
